evidence_requirements.description: Event date compared with research_clock: is the event today, yesterday or older; is the session complete.
evidence_requirements.fallback: State the assumption and that the date is unverified.

evidence_requirements.description: Offer price, shares, venue, ticker and pricing date from the issuer or regulator filing.
evidence_requirements.fallback: Use news for terms and label them secondary. Where filings do not cover the issuer, use issuer_documents for its own offer announcements.

evidence_requirements.description: First trade time and price, open, high, low, close and volume of the event session.
evidence_requirements.fallback: Use news figures, label them NOT market data, say they are unverified and that the market-data key is needed to verify.

evidence_requirements.description: MARKET BENCHMARK: a broad index or index ETF for the same session and window.
evidence_requirements.acceptance: same dates as the event series
evidence_requirements.fallback: State that no benchmark could be fetched and why; do not infer market direction from news alone.

evidence_requirements.description: After-hours or next-session information if the session is not complete.
evidence_requirements.fallback: Note that extended-hours data was not obtained.

look_for: whether the move was market-wide rather than event-specific
whether the listing actually occurred when claimed
supply or lock-up and valuation concerns
counter_evidence.if_none_found: State what was searched and that no contrary evidence was found.

unit_and_period_checks: exchange time zone vs reader time zone
session boundaries and whether the close is final
event-day change vs offer price vs previous close are different baselines

reconciliation.note: report differences and prefer market data

stopping_conditions: offer terms, session figures and benchmark obtained or each gap explained
the event is not yet in a completed session: report the status and stop

must_state: as-of date and session of each series
coverage gaps, especially missing market data or benchmark
which numbers come from news and are not market data

limits: market_data needs the user's own key; without it session figures stay secondary and must be labelled
a newly listed instrument may be missing from market-data coverage
